notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in your hand that is greater than your maximum hand size.
description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Magmakin Artillerist trigger, dealing damage to each opponent.
Kefka triggers, causing you to draw a card for each opponent that lost life.
Repeat from step 3 as needed for all remaining Magmakin Artillerist triggers.
Once all players have passed priority and the stack is empty, you will still be in your cleanup step, and will discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
